item.title: Trainee/Junior Full Stack JavaScript Developer (React/Node)
item.description:
Insiders is a fast-growing IT company which employs about 200 people. Our company focused on providing innovative digital services and cutting-edge technologies to solve complex business challenges.

 

We are located in Lviv and currently work in an office format. For candidates from other cities, we offer relocation (an apartment located near the office, this option is free).

 

What we expect from the candidate:

•Solid understanding and ability to the practical application of HTML/CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript. 

•Proofed experience in Node.js with Express.js and Nest.js frameworks.

 •Knowledge of MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis.

•Deep knowledge and understanding of networking - REST API standards, HTTP/HTTPS methods. 

•Solid understanding of React/Next.js. 

•Experience with Git. 

 

what we offer:

- free study in our Corporate English Academy

- growth and development opportunities for young developers even if you have no commercial experience

- regular salary review (after the completion of each contract)

- provision of Apple equipment

- comfortable office with all amenities not far from the center (uninterrupted internet, generator, tea and coffee, pastries).

- timely payment of salaries.

- corporate events, teambuildings, etc.

- working on projects side by side with Senior developers, which will give you the opportunity to learn and develop.

item.title: Full Stack Developer (Intern)
item.description:

  • Actively leverage tools such as Claude Max to improve development efficiency

  • Designed for university students currently undergoing their studies

item.title: Trainee/Junior Full Stack Angular/.NET Developer
item.description:
🔎About SoftPlus Ukraine

SoftPlus Ukraine is a growing software development company with roots in Ukraine and partnerships around the globe. We collaborate with companies of all sizes and stages — from ambitious startups to established enterprises. What unites our team is a shared passion for technology, a commitment to quality, and a drive to keep improving every day.

 

Our people are at the heart of what we do. We’re a diverse team of skilled professionals working remotely across different cities and countries, yet closely connected through teamwork, knowledge-sharing, and mutual support.

 

📌The Role

We’re looking for a Trainee/Junior Full Stack Angular/.NET Developer who is eager to learn, grow, and contribute to real-world projects from day one. This is a great opportunity if you have a solid foundation in programming and want to put your skills into practice while building modern, user-friendly applications.

 

In this role, you’ll work closely with experienced developers, gaining hands-on experience in Angular, .NET Core, and MS SQL. You’ll be part of a supportive team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

 

📋Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in identifying and fixing bugs and issues in the codebase
  • Contribute to full-stack development
  • Support database maintenance tasks, including writing SQL queries and helping optimize performance
  • Participate in code reviews with more experienced developers to learn best practices and coding standards
  • Help refactor existing code to improve efficiency, readability, and maintainability
  • Collaborate closely with senior developers, gaining hands-on experience and guidance in both front-end and back-end development

 

📝Requirements

  • Completed or ongoing Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Solid understanding of software development principles and best practices
  • Demonstrated coding skills with pet projects available on GitHub (or similar platform), preferably in C#
  • Hands-on (non-commercial) experience with:
    • .NET Core (EF Core, MVC, Onion Architecture, or CQRS)
    • SQL databases
  • English proficiency at B1+ level
  • Availability for a full-time schedule: 12:00 – 20:30 (Mon–Fri, including a 30-minute lunch break)
  • Willingness to participate in regular team meetings during working hours
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

 

✅Would Be a Plus:

Experience with Angular (or any other JS) framework

 

﻿﻿What We Offer﻿

💸  Paid probation period — 4 weeks of full-time, hands-on experience before official hiring﻿

📈  Growth opportunities — clear paths for professional development and career advancement﻿

🔋 Supportive culture — a friendly, collaborative environment where your ideas matter﻿﻿

🖥️  Modern projects — work with cutting-edge technologies on meaningful, real-world applications﻿

💡 Talented team — join a motivated group of professionals who are always ready to share knowledge and help you grow

 

Join our team at SoftPlus Ukraine and contribute to the success of our innovative projects. 
Apply now!

item.title: Junior JavaScript + Java Engineer
item.description:
We are looking for a Junior JavaScript + Java Developer to join our team and contribute to the development and support of a modern CRM system.

 

You will work across both frontend and backend, using JavaScript/React and Java, while gaining practical experience with APIs, data processing, third-party integrations, and real-world product development.

 

This role is a great opportunity for a junior developer who wants to strengthen their JavaScript skills while also developing a solid foundation in Java backend development and gradually grow into a full-stack engineer.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Develop and maintain web applications using JavaScript, React, and Java
  • Work with Java-based backend services and RESTful APIs
  • Implement and support frontend functionality using React
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs
  • Work with data parsing, transformation, and processing
  • Write clean, readable, and maintainable code
  • Debug issues and improve application performance
  • Work with JSON, HTTP, asynchronous operations, and data structures
  • Collaborate with developers and stakeholders in an Agile environment

  • Participate in code reviews and gradually take ownership of development tasks

     

Requirements

 

  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of JavaScript
  • Basic understanding of React
  • Basic knowledge of Java and object-oriented programming
  • Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and client-server architecture
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and browser Developer Tools
  • Understanding of JSON, data structures, and asynchronous programming
  • Basic understanding of Java backend concepts and ability to work with existing Java code
  • Familiarity with Git and version control workflows
  • Ability to write or understand basic scripts for data parsing and transformation
  • Basic understanding of databases and SQL
  • Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn

  • English: Upper-Intermediate or higher

     

Nice to Have

 

  • Experience with Spring / Spring Boot
  • Experience with Node.js
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or other databases
  • Experience with Postman or similar API testing tools
  • Understanding of Maven or Gradle
  • Experience with Java-based backend systems
  • Any experience using or integrating AI-powered tools or services
  • Exposure to Agile / Scrum workflows

  • Experience working with third-party APIs or integrations

     

What We Offer

 

  • Competitive salary and bonuses
  • Remote-first culture
  • Flexible schedule
  • Open-minded, results-driven environment
  • Opportunity to work with both JavaScript and Java
  • Mentorship and opportunities for professional growth
  • Product ownership and real impact on the development process

item.title: Junior Full-Stack JavaScript Developer
item.description:
We’re expanding our engineering team and looking for developers who are comfortable building production-grade React and Node.js applications for early-stage companies in healthcare, fintech, and AI.

Although the role is primarily front-end oriented, the ability to contribute to backend services in Node.js is important.

You’ll join a team with clear processes, a modern stack, and a strong engineering culture.
 

What you will do

  • Develop web applications using React and related tooling.
  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs with Node.js (Nest.js or similar frameworks).
  • Work with cloud environments and containerized setups using tools like Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, propose improvements, and help maintain technical standards.
  • Implement new features from specification to production.


What we expect

  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
  • Strong practical experience with React
  • Familiarity with Node.js (Nest.js or Express).
  • Experience developing APIs using Node.js frameworks.
  • Understanding of relational or NoSQL databases (Postgres, MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase).
  • Ability to write maintainable, well-structured code and follow best practices.
  • English at an Intermediate level or higher.


Additional advantages

  • Experience with major cloud providers (AWS, Google Cloud).
  • Experience with React Native
  • Practical understanding of Docker/Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).


What we offer

  • Engaging projects built with a modern, well-supported tech stack.
  • A review process that ensures consistent feedback and knowledge sharing.
  • A culture focused on continuous learning and professional development.
  • Full remote work with a team distributed across multiple countries.
  • Competitive compensation in USD with periodic performance reviews.
  • Flexible payment methods tailored to your location.
  • Work schedule aligned with your time zone.
  • English practice sessions.
  • Paid sick leave and annual vacation (15 business days).
  • Regular team activities online.
  • Coverage of monthly psychologist support sessions.

item.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Go/React) Europe
item.description:
🚀 Senior Full Stack Developer (Go/React) Europe🚀

 

 

 We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join a company that builds global business communication and messaging solutions, helping businesses connect with their customers through SMS, WhatsApp, voice, email and other communication channels. 

 

 

🔹 What you’ll do: 

Design and develop new platform capabilities across backend & frontend 

Work with Go-based microservices, APIs and event-driven architecture 

Build and improve React + TypeScript interfaces 

Work with external integrations, billing systems and high-throughput APIs 

Investigate and solve complex production issues 

Participate in system design, architecture and technical discussions Own technical initiatives end-to-end 

 

 

🔹 Requirements: 

4+ years of commercial Full Stack experience 

3+ years with Go, including concurrency, performance and system design 

2+ years with React + TypeScript 

Experience with distributed systems / microservices 

Strong understanding of SQL & NoSQL 

Ability to debug complex issues across multiple services

 Comfortable working in an environment where requirements evolve 

 

 

⭐ Nice to have: 

Experience with real-time systems, messaging or telecom

Kafka or similar event-streaming technologies

GCP or other cloud platforms 

Billing systems / high-throughput APIs 

 

 

🌍 Remote 💻 Full-time If you’re interested in building scalable communication products and working on systems used for global customer interactions, we’d love to hear from you.
